g.text: Pump combinations add heads in series and flows in parallel at equal head

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Hypothetical steady curves with no branch imbalance or additional manifold loss. Series head is2Hp(Q); parallel head is Hp(Q/2) for identical sharing.
Operating flows follow intersections with the unchanged system curve and do not simply double. Efficiency, NPSH, controls and motor limits omitted.
